title: Game definition: Bao (East African mancala)
description: Bao la Kiswahili: 2-player, 4×8 board (32 pits), 64 seeds. Two phases: namua (placement from captured seeds) and mtaji (sowing from board). Captures from opponent's front row. Most complex mancala variant — UNESCO intangible heritage candidate.
close_reason: Bao la Kiswahili: 4×8 board, 64 seeds, namua/mtaji phases, relay sowing, kula capture, nyumba special pit. Validates against schema.
